Class ThemeCreator

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.themecreator.ThemeCreator
public final class ThemeCreator extends Object
Desktop theme workbench with native menu previews and an optionally detached color editor. The color resolver is shared with Minecraft; previews do not duplicate its menus.

  • Constructor Details

    • ThemeCreator

      private ThemeCreator(Path themes, Path initial) throws IOException
      Loads the shared theme catalog and initial immutable draft before building Swing controls. All editor state is owned by the event-dispatch thread.
      Throws:
      IOException

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] arguments)
      Starts Theme Creator. The optional themes directory makes Save As open in a Minecraft instance's theme folder.
      Parameters:
      arguments - optional --themes-directory folder and --theme file

    • buildWindows

      private void buildWindows()
      Builds file commands, theme discovery, menu navigation and the docked preview/editor layout. Selection changes update controls without editing the document; closing either window preserves unsaved work.

    • buildEditor

      private JPanel buildEditor()
      Builds the palette and selected-part workflows. Programmatic control updates are guarded by refreshing so that displaying a color cannot create an undo entry.

    • target

      private ThemeDraft.Target target()
      Resolves the current palette token or element/menu/global editing scope. The same target is used by the picker, hex field, reset and clipboard commands.

    • changes

      private static DocumentListener changes(Runnable action)
      Runs an editor refresh for every kind of text-document change. The receiving action must ignore programmatic updates while refreshing is true.

    • toggleEditor

      private void toggleEditor()
      Moves the existing editor component between the split pane and its secondary window. It never copies the draft or creates another set of listeners.

    • themeSwatch

      private static Icon themeSwatch(ThemeDefinition.Compiled theme)
      Shows representative resolved surface, text and button colors beside a theme name, including inherited palette values.

    • paletteHelp

      private String paletteHelp(String token)
      Explains the intended use of common palette tokens; custom tokens remain valid without a built-in description.

    • usePath

      private void usePath()
      Validates an advanced element selector before making it the editing target. Choosing a path alone leaves the theme unchanged.

    • linkPalette

      private void linkPalette()
      Stores a palette reference at the current target, so subsequent palette edits propagate to that part. Cancelling the chooser leaves the draft intact.

    • showJson

      private void showJson()
      Displays a read-only serialization of the current draft for inspection and copying. This does not save or replace the document.

    • showHelp

      private void showHelp()
      Explains the main editing workflow, scoped commands and keyboard shortcuts without requiring knowledge of the JSON schema.

    • colorMenu

      private JPopupMenu colorMenu()
      Creates commands for the part selected by the preview click. Each invocation reads the current target rather than retaining an obsolete selection.

    • select

      private void select(PreviewAtlas.Slot slot)
      Turns a native mask hit into an element/property target, synchronizes menu navigation and opens the selected-part workflow. Selection itself is not an edit.

    • filterRoles

      private void filterRoles()
      Contextual properties are the default; advanced search includes the complete shared role catalog.

    • paletteTokens

      private Set<String> paletteTokens()
      Combines inherited and authored palette names in stable order, including custom tokens from user themes.

    • rebuildPalette

      private void rebuildPalette()
      Rebuilds palette buttons after loading a document so custom tokens are selectable. Button colors are refreshed from the compiled draft.

    • selectedColor

      private int selectedColor()
      Returns the effective ARGB value after inheritance and selector precedence; this is also the color copied to the clipboard.

    • refreshEditor

      private void refreshEditor()
      Synchronizes widgets and comparison swatches from the current draft. Suppressing change listeners here prevents recursive edits and accidental undo steps.

    • hexChanged

      private void hexChanged()
      Applies only complete, valid hex input. Incomplete typing retains the previous preview, and one focused editing gesture becomes one undo step.

    • picked

      private void picked(int color)
      Applies a picker or opacity value at the current target, then updates the hex field and schedules a coalesced preview repaint.

    • changed

      private void changed()
      Refreshes editor state after a document command and coalesces expensive preview recoloring through the repaint timer.

    • refreshPreview

      private void refreshPreview()
      Recolors only the visible preview and updates the unsaved marker. Camera changes and selections remain separate from the authoring document.

    • copy

      private void copy()
      Copies the resolved color as normalized hex without changing the theme or its undo history.

    • colorComparison

      private static Icon colorComparison(int before, int after)
      Builds saved/current swatches over a checkerboard so opacity changes remain visible on both light and dark colors.

    • cut

      private void cut()
      Copies the effective color before removing its override in the chosen scope. Resetting restores inheritance rather than guessing a replacement color.

    • paste

      private void paste(ThemeDraft.Scope destination)
      Normalizes a clipboard hex value and applies it to the current or explicitly chosen scope as one undoable edit. Invalid clipboard contents leave the draft unchanged.

    • pasteMenu

      private void pasteMenu(JComponent anchor)
      Offers destinations appropriate to the current workflow. Palette editing pastes into the token; part editing can target one part, one menu or all menus.

    • addPaste

      private void addPaste(JPopupMenu menu, String label, ThemeDraft.Scope scope)
      Binds one menu item to an explicit destination scope; the actual color is read when the command runs.

    • shortcuts

      private void shortcuts(JComponent root)
      Installs window-level file and color commands for both docked and detached workflows. Focused text controls retain their ordinary text-editing bindings.

    • bind

      private static void bind(JComponent root, int key, int modifiers, String id, Runnable action)
      Registers a named action on the root pane so the same command works while any non-text child control has focus.

    • open

      private void open()
      Offers to save unsaved work before choosing and reading another UTF-8 theme file. Parse failures retain the current document.

    • load

      private void load(ThemeDefinition document, Path file)
      Validates a replacement draft before installing it, then rebuilds custom controls and clears the previous selection. A null file denotes a new copy rather than an overwrite target.

    • collectCustomRoles

      private void collectCustomRoles(ThemeDefinition document)
      Adds authored global and rule-local property names to the advanced catalog, keeping unfamiliar extension roles editable.

    • save

      private boolean save()
      Writes the current file, or delegates to Save As for a new copy. Saved-state bookkeeping changes only after a successful write; false cancels the caller’s pending operation.

    • export

      private boolean export()
      Collects a destination and display metadata, validates the proposed document, then writes it before updating the draft. Cancelling or failing any step preserves the current file and saved state.

    • invalidColor

      private void invalidColor()
      Explains why saving is blocked by incomplete hex input and returns focus to the field without discarding the last valid color.

    • confirmDiscard

      private boolean confirmDiscard()
      Returns whether a close/load operation may continue. Save failure or cancellation vetoes the operation; only an explicit Discard abandons changes.

    • error

      private void error(Exception failure)
      Shows an operation failure while keeping the draft available for correction or another save destination.

      private static JButton button(String text, Runnable action)
      Creates a command button that delegates to the same action used by menus and shortcuts.

      Creates a wrapping guidance block sized for the narrow editor pane.

      Adds fixed vertical breathing room without allowing BoxLayout to stretch the separator.
